People: Wilhelm Raabe (author, Wikidata Q60647), died 1910; Ernst Bosch (illustrator, Wikidata Q111027), died 1917. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Raabe, Wilhelm, 1831-1910; Bosch, Ernst, 1834-1917 [Illustrator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: die chronik der sperlingsgasse, 1856, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/diechronikderspe00wilh. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 100%, 80%, 83% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Ernst Bosch, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
